Best dim sum in Ho Chi Minh City
Sep 2026 • Couples
Best dim sum in Ho Chi Minh city!!!
We came here because we fancied some Dim Sum and boy did they deliver. We took advantage of the All you can eat offer and when bombarded by the sheer bounty of choice we were deftly guided by Thuy our waitress, who among our choices suggested some excellent items we would have missed. The siu mai in particular was utterly divine: meaty, satisfying and absolutely delicious. Other must eats include the mustard and mayo prawns, the beef in black pepper sauce, and the charcoal prawn and chive dim sum.
You MUST visit this place. Exceptional value and fantastic quality. I would absolutely eat here again.

A Wonderful Dining at Kabin
Aug 2026 • Family
I had a wonderful dining experience at Kabin! The food was absolutely delicious, and all the staff were incredibly friendly, sweet, and attentive. They took such great care of me throughout the whole meal.
A special thank you to Ms.Tu and Mr.Hieu, who kindly checked in on my family and thoughtfully recommended some really delicious dishes for our meal. Their genuine care and attention made the experience even more special.
I will definitely come back to Kabin, not only for the great food but also for the warm, attentive, and heartfelt service. Highly recommended!

Excellent Experience
Aug 2026 • Family
Had a really enjoyable experience here. The restaurant has a beautiful atmosphere that feels elegant without being too formal or stuffy. The dim sum was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented, with each dish having its own unique flavor. Our Trân and Tiến were both incredibly friendly, and attentive throughout the meal. They made us feel very welcome and took the time to recommend dishes and check in on us without being intrusive. Overall, great food, lovely ambiance, and excellent service. Definitely a place I’d happily come back to.
